description: The plot illustrates the training and validation loss trajectories for two experimental configurations, Ex1 and Ex2, during the Embedding and LM Head training stage of the RedWhale Korean LLM. The x-axis, labeled “Step,” spans from 0 to 600,000 in linear increments of 100,000, representing the number of training steps. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” is displayed on a linear scale ranging from 2 × 10⁰ to 1.2 × 10¹, with major gridlines at 2 × 10⁰, 3 × 10⁰, 4 × 10⁰, 6 × 10⁰, 10¹, and 1.1 × 10¹. Four distinct lines are plotted: Ex1 Loss (solid blue line with circular markers) begins at approximately 3.8 × 10⁰, drops steeply to around 2.1 × 10⁰ by 100,000 steps, and continues to decline gradually to approximately 1.9 × 10⁰ by 600,000 steps. Ex2 Loss (solid cyan line with circular markers) starts at about 3.2 × 10⁰, decreases to roughly 2.3 × 10⁰ by 200,000 steps, and then stabilizes near 2.1 × 10⁰ for the remainder of training. Ex1 Validation Loss (dashed blue line with circular markers) begins above 1.1 × 10¹, falls sharply to approximately 3.1 × 10⁰ by 100,000 steps, and remains relatively flat near 3.0 × 10⁰ thereafter. Ex2 Validation Loss (dashed cyan line with circular markers) starts slightly below 1.1 × 10¹, declines to about 4.5 × 10⁰ by 200,000 steps, and then stabilizes around 3.3 × 10⁰, consistently remaining higher than Ex1 Validation Loss across all steps.
caption_used: Loss comparison of Ex1 and Ex2 during the Embedding and LM Head training stage. The plot shows that Ex1 Loss starts at approximately 4 × 10⁰ and steadily declines to less than 2 × 10⁰ by 60,000 steps, while Ex2 Loss begins at around 3 × 10⁰ and stabilizes at 2.5 × 10⁰ after 20,000 steps. Ex1 Validation Loss starts above 1.1 × 10¹ and decreases sharply to 3 × 10⁰ by 10,000 steps, then stabilizes. Ex2 Validation Loss begins slightly below 1.1 × 10¹ and declines to 4 × 10⁰ by 20,000 steps, remaining higher than Ex1 Validation Loss throughout the training process.
